_about: The Automations ring in the Second Brain: hidden agentic, automation and self-learning jobs. refresh/sources/automations.cjs reads Windows scheduled tasks and Claude hooks live; this file only says which ones belong and what each one writes. "learns" = it rewrites skills, knowledge, memory or agent instructions. Paths in "writes" are relative to this folder unless absolute.

Agentic HQ Boot Check.desc: After sign-in: checks Agentic HQ, the Brain engine and native companions, and starts what's missing.

Agentic HQ PC Sentinel.desc: Every 2h: disk space, leaked headless browsers, RAM and page file.

Agentic HQ Usage Guard.desc: Hourly: usage meter history and projected burn-out before reset.

Agentic HQ Repeat Check.desc: Daily 9 AM: checks Learned and AI Radar for repeated items. Exact repeats push an alert; look-alikes go to the 8 PM digest.

Agentic HQ Gotcha Proposals.desc: Turns lessons and the failure registry into proposed skill Gotcha patches for you to approve.

Agentic HQ Weekly Dev Health.desc: Weekly: repo and dependency health across projects, plus the lesson-to-Gotcha review.

Agentic HQ Second Brain Refresh.desc: Rebuilds the Second Brain map and snapshots.

usage-check.desc: After edits and agent launches: warns when the 5h window is low and a handoff is due.

agent-checkpoint.desc: Saves a resume point before compaction and shows it on session start.
